entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. To best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
The heart rate tracking is a joke. It's completely inaccurate. The whole thing is just garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the accuracy. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Often, a quick software recalibration can resolve that. Do you have a moment to try a few steps with me?
No. I don't have time for that. Look, I just want my money back. I need a refund.
I understand your frustration and that you'd prefer a direct return. Let me just pull up your account and review the order details and our policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for holding. I see your VeloBand Pulse was delivered 36 days ago. Let me just check the policy here... and yes, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Absolutely. Since you're within the 10-day period, I can authorize this return for a full refund. I will email you a prepaid return shipping label right away.

It's on its way to your email now. Also, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. To apologize for the faulty device and thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a $20 VeloFit credit to your account for any future purchase.
You're welcome. Once we receive the returned band, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
